payload.text: Home - BCM Inks Slide We're ready to formulate for your success. And it starts with the ink. Let's Get Formulating We are BCM Inks Your trusted partner for corrugated ink and solutions. Who We Are | Our Story | Giving Back BCM Inks leads the way in sustainably-made water-based inks for corrugated packaging. We match every color, customize every order, and meet every customer challenge with our trademark efficiency and quick turn-around time. Inks and Varnishes BCM’s high-quality water flexo inks and varnishes make printing easier and more efficient. Our high-performance products are known in the industry for their: Durability and rub resistance. Gloss and color intensity. Sustainability and innovation. Efficiency and ease of use. Find out how our inks and varnishes can ensure your next project is a success. Color Management Through our innovative color management services, we pre-engineer success for printers by offering: Fast and accurate CEILAB-based color matching. 24-hour color proof turnaround. Brand color management. Color ConneXion® software for blending systems. See how Color ConneXion® can help you grow your business. Blending Systems We offer a range of blending systems for printers. In fact, 80% of our customers use blending systems in their facility because these systems: Increase profits. Provide more flexibility. Lower costs. Find out which BCM Inks blending system can take your production to the next level. Why Choose BCM Inks Complete solutions for the corrugated packaging industry BCM Inks makes the highest quality water-based inks, expertly color-matched for your needs. We’re also the only company to have developed a proprietary color management software called Color ConneXion®, which specifically serves the corrugated industry. Customer service that goes the extra mile When you call BCM Inks, we answer the phone. We get to know you, and work to set you up for success with every print job. Because we’re family-owned and independently operated, we can go the extra mile—and we always do. Innovative and sustainable from the start We’ve been shaking up this industry for 30+ years, offering new products year after year. We pioneered water-based inks for corrugated and have continually improved the technology. We’ve also been offering sustainable products from the start, including an award-winning line of eco-friendly inks. BCM Inks is the partner of choice for the biggest and best brands. From Our Customers We greatly appreciate the strategic partnership that has evolved. The level of professionalism and support is unmatched. Always deliver in timely manner, even when given short notice. Support in technologies and training are very appreciated to our production team. Keep up the good work. We are very well pleased. Just wanted you and your team to know how I think your products are the top of the industry. We just had a test run for a client and your ink sets helped us do things I didn’t think we could do. A More Sustainable Choice… [/contact] Contact - BCM Inks Contact - BCM Inks BCM Inks is a privately owned company with headquarters in Cincinnati, Ohio, with an additional facility in Monterrey, Mexico and distributorship in Santiago, Chile. BCM Inks is committed to improving the corrugated industry’s direct print capabilities through innovative and award-winning custom products, superior technical expertise, technological advancement, and exceptional service and education. We are a multinational leader, marketing our inks and varnishes throughout the U.S., Mexico, Central America, and South America. We enjoy hearing from our customers and receiving new queries. Give us a call at (877) BCM-INKS or tell us more about your needs by submitting an online inquiry below. We’re looking forward to serving you. Home
